title: Samsung makes its Galaxy A series devices more expensive in the US too
description: Last week, Samsung hiked the prices of its high-end devices in the US (along with Europe and India), and today the company has raised the prices of its low-end and mid-range phones in the US as well. Samsung Galaxy A57 We're talking about the Galaxy A17, A27, A37, and A57. The A17 is now $270, up from $200 when it launched. The A27 now goes for $380, up from $350 when it was released. The A37 now costs $490, up from $450 when it arrived. [#InlinePriceWidget,14041,1#] [#InlinePriceWidget,14606,1#] Finally, the Galaxy A57 is now $600, $50 more than when it debuted - but that...

title: The Galaxy S27 Ultra could be available in these base color options
description: The upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra’s base color options have leaked. The flagship phone is expected to be unveiled in a couple of months with a new rear camera design, a bigger battery, and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. According to tipster Ice Universe, the Galaxy S27 Ultra will be available in Black, Blue, Light Pink, and White color options. Ice also claimed that the phone will be available in a special Violet shade, similar to its predecessor. Leaked Galaxy S27 Ultra CAD render in Black We’ve already seen the flagship in Black through recently leaked CAD...

title: Infinix Smart 20E leaks in four colors, some specs outed too
description: Infinix launched the Smart 20 in March, and now it's apparently working on a companion device in the same family, called the Smart 20E. This has been leaked today in four colors, as you can see below. Its design seems nigh-on identical to the already available Infinix Smart 20. The Smart 20E has already been certified by the FCC with the model number X6843. That certification has revealed a version with 6GB of RAM and 128GB of storage, and the fact that the device will be 4G-only. According to today's leak, the Smart 20E will have the same 6.78-inch LCD display as the Smart 20,...

title: Oppo K15s and K15x debut in China with familiar specs
description: The Oppo K15 series has two additional members in China: the K15s and K15x. While new in name, the pair share their key hardware with previously launched Oppo models. The K15s is a rebadged Oppo A7 Pro featuring the same core specs and design, while the K15x is basically an Oppo K14 but with a slightly smaller battery capacity of 6,500 mAh. Oppo K15s and its key specs Oppo K15s features a 6.57-inch AMOLED (FHD+ 120Hz) and MediaTek’s Dimensity 6360 Max chipset alongside up to 8GB RAM and 256GB storage. It also brings a 50MP main cam on the back and an 8MP front-facing...

title: Huawei and Qualcomm sign patent cross-licensing deal for 5G, AI and other tech
description: Huawei and Qualcomm just signed a broad, multi-year cross-licensing agreement that covers 5G, compute, AI and networking technologies developed by the two companies. This is the first 5G licensing agreement between the two. As part of the deal, Qualcomm will buy several US patents from Huawei – they cover developments in compute, AI, networking and other technologies. This deal is subject to regulatory approval and Huawei has been subject to trade restrictions by the US since 2019, so we’ll see how the US Commerce Department feels about this. The two companies came out with a shared...

title: Gurman: touchscreen MacBook Pros are launching next month
description: The touchscreen MacBook has earned mythical creature status over the years, and we’re closing in on its debut, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. Apple is expected to launch 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pros armed with touchscreen OLED panels sometime next month. While we’ve already seen plenty of leaked info on the OLED MacBooks, Gurman’s latest report specifies that the new laptops will be “significantly lighter” than the current models. We don’t get a specific value, but according to the new report, Apple implemented a new internal component structure that has allowed them to shed...

title: Realme P4s Lite goes official with a 7,000mAh battery
description: The Realme P4s, which launched in India in August, is now getting a new variant. Realme appears to have quietly unveiled the P4s Lite in the country, with slightly lower specifications than the standard P4s. Realme’s new phone has been listed on its official India website, revealing its pricing, specifications, and availability. The Realme P4s Lite features a 6.75-inch LCD display with an HD+ resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. It is powered by the Unisoc T7250 chipset, paired with LPDDR4X RAM and UFS 2.2 storage. One of the phone’s key highlights is its 7,000mAh battery, which...

title: Oppo F35 and F35 Pro debut with 8,000mAh batteries and 50MP selfie cameras
description: Right on schedule, Oppo unveiled the F35 series in India. They’ve grown heavier compared to their predecessors, the F33 and F33 Pro, since they bring bigger batteries. The new Pro is also equipped with a larger display, an extra camera and more oomph, while the new vanilla model can stop being envious of the Pro’s selfie camera. The Oppo F35 Pro now has a 6.78” OLED display, a 1,272 x 2,772px panel with up to 144Hz refresh rate. It renders 10-bit colors with 100% coverage of the DCI-P3 color space. It peaks at 1,800 nits of brightness in HBM mode and is protected by AGC DT-Star D+ glass....

title: Oppo F35 Pro hands-on
description: The Oppo F35 series launched in India in two flavors - F35 Pro and a non-Pro F35. We had the chance to play around with the Pro version, which is a feature-packed all-rounder, similar to the more affordable vanilla F35 in more than one way. Oppo F35 Pro While both Oppo F35 handsets feature 50MP main and 50MP front cameras, only the Pro gets an ultrawide shooter with 8MP resolution. It's also running on a more powerful Dimensity 7360 Max chipset, while the non-Pro settles for a Dimensity 6360 Max. Oppo F35 Pro The Pro's hardware also allows 4K video recording, while the...

title: Here's your first look at Google's next fitness tracker, the Fitbit Edge
description: Back in August, Google Australia accidentally revealed an upcoming Fitbit device in official promo images during the Pixel 11 series launch. Now, a new report has revealed the design and key features of the product, which is said to be called the Fitbit Edge. The report claims that Google will unveil the Fitbit Edge later this month, positioning it between the Fitbit Air and Pixel Watch 5. According to the report, the Fitbit Edge will succeed the Fitbit Charge and feature an oval touchscreen, GPS, and up to 7 days of battery life. It will also offer limited app support for apps...

title: Beats 360 review
description: The Beats 360 are the newest pair of headphones from Apple-owned Beats by Dre, and are aimed specifically at those looking for a pair of headphones to use during workouts. They have a lightweight, durable design as well as IPX4 water and sweat resistance. The mesh fabric ear cups and headband are also removable and easy to replace, with multiple color and material options. The Beats 360 could also be seen as a more affordable alternative to the Apple AirPods Max 2, with many of the same Apple-exclusive features, plus Android compatibility, thrown in for good measure. At the $350...

title: Weekly poll: are you interested in the vivo X Fold6?
description: The vivo X Fold6 launched on July 1 in China and is now starting its worldwide tour – it’s already available in Europe and is expected to launch in India next week. So, now the question is this – are you planning on buying one? First, we have to look at the price and we immediately run into issues. vivo left the UK a while ago, the German site hasn’t been updated in ages. The company’s coverage in Europe is pretty spotty. We did find the phone in Spain where it costs €1,980 (down from an MSRP of €2,200) and comes with a 100W charger. While vivo Germany doesn’t have it, vivo Austria does,...

title: Deals: here's how to avoid the Galaxy S26 series price hike
description: In case you missed it, Samsung increased the Galaxy S26 prices globally – in the US, they are $100 higher than they were at launch seven months ago. And even back then, most configurations cost more than the equivalent S25 models did last year. However, it’s not too late to pick up a Galaxy S26, S26+ or S26 Ultra at a good price. Your best bet at the moment is probably Walmart – not only has the retailer not applied the new prices, but it is even selling the phones at a discount compared to the old prices. In the case of the S26 Ultra, that is up to $500 off. Samsung’s revised price for...

title: Weekly poll results: pricing will decide the fate of the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max
description: Last week, we asked you for your thoughts on Xiaomi’s 18 Pro series in light of the news that the series is going global. Xiaomi is still mum on the details, but one thing is clear – the price will determine how popular these two phones become. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max has the upper hand – while a lot of people are price sensitive, quite a few have already committed to getting one based on what they’ve seen so far. Around 5% of voters plan to hold out for an Ultra model down the line, but they are in the minority. Besides the Ultra, the vivo X500 Pro Max emerged as a competitor in the...

title: Our Redmi Note 17 4G battery life and charging tests are ready
description: Does a market for 4G phones still exist? Xiaomi thinks so, so it released the Redmi Note 17 4G. We’ve already looked at the battery life and charging tests of its 5G sibling and promised to compare the two in a separate article – this is that article. We will, of course, compare it with other models too, but which ones? We tried to pick out mostly 4G phones for this comparison, however, we just don’t review that many 4G phones – so, we had no choice but to put the Redmi Note 17 4G against a group of mostly 5G phones. title: Deals: Amazon's early Prime Deals slash the prices of foldables and flagships
description: Amazon will kick off Prime Deal Days on October 6 (Tuesday next week). The sales event will run for two days, but you don’t have to wait for it to start as the retailer is already offering some great early Prime Day deals. For example, the Galaxy Z Fold8 is nearly €600 off and the Z Fold8 Ultra is nearly €700 off. title: This is when the Honor Magic9 series is landing in Europe
description: Honor launched the Magic9, Magic9 Super, and Magic9 Pro Max in China a few days ago. If the devices interest you, you may want to know when to expect them to arrive in Europe. Today we have the answer for the UK and France, officially revealed by Honor's website. Obviously, the rest of Europe is likely to get them at the same time. Over in the UK and France, Honor says the Magic9 series is landing in January. That's quite the wait, no doubt. The company is showing the Magic9 Pro Max in Shadow Black, Moss Green, and Glacier Silver on its official website. The device will be offered...

title: iQOO 16 is headed to India, but at what price?
description: The iQOO 16 became official in China earlier this week. Now if you've been wondering whether it will be available in India, a tipster over on X today tells us that it's a real possibility, as the phone has allegedly started some testing procedures in the country. So it's pretty likely that it will launch in India in the coming weeks. However, the big question is how much it will end up costing. Over in China, it starts at CNY 5,999, which is about INR 86,000 or $894. The aforementioned tipster claims it could actually be priced closer to INR 100,000 ($1,039), which would definitely...

title: WhatsApp's Restricted Chat feature is now available to beta users on Android and iOS
description: Last month, we learned that WhatsApp was developing a feature called Restricted Chat as an upgrade to Advanced Chat Privacy. The feature is now rolling out to some Android and iOS users enrolled in WhatsApp's beta program. WABetaInfo reports that Restricted Chat is available to some WhatsApp users on beta version 2.26.36.4 of WhatsApp for Android and 26.39.10.20 of WhatsApp for iOS. What is WhatsApp's Restricted Chat feature, and what does it do? For those unaware, the Restricted Chat feature - like Advanced Chat Privacy - is optional, so it's not enabled for all chats by default. It...

title: Honor Magic9 series is official, Motorola's wide foldable coming, Week 40 in review
description: Honor unveiled its Magic9 flagship series in China, consisting of the Magic9, Magic9 Super Edition, and the range-topping Magic9 Pro Max. The regular Magic9 pairs a compact 6.37-inch 120Hz OLED with a huge 8,000mAh battery, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, and dual 200MP main and periscope cameras. The Magic9 Super Edition goes even further on battery capacity with an enormous 11,000mAh cell and adds a 30,000rpm active cooling fan.
